question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Famine**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The blank requires a word that fits in the context of the other options, which all relate to negative situations.
 
• **Famine **fits in the context of negative situations and relates to the idea of scarcity or lack of resources. (अनाहार)
 
 
• **Example**: *The prolonged drought led to a severe famine in the region.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pregnancy**: The state of being pregnant. (गर्भावस्था)
 
• **Overpopulation**: The condition of having too many people in a given area. (जनसंख्या)
 
• **Surgery**: Medical procedure involving incisions or manipulations of the body. (शल्य चिकित्सा)
